attributes.action: Knight English footballer Djed Spence for historical international preformances.
attributes.additional_details: May you sign my petition to knight djed Spence to make him “sir djed Spence” because of his heroic actions in fifa World Cup 2026 representing our country leading us to our fourth ever World Cup semi finals
attributes.background: My petition is about awarding Djed Spence by being knighted for his historically brave and fearful international preformances for our country playing and important role in our journey to the semi finals of this years FIFA World Cup. This position is highly deserved by him as he played a major role.
